description: This is a FastAPI backend module defining REST API endpoints related to submission workflows in a data insights platform. It handles creating, retrieving, validating, and approving submissions, with detailed authentication, authorization, and error handling logic.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router object used to define API routes

methods.name: CreateSubmissionResponse create_submission( request: CreateSubmissionRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security) )
methods.description: API endpoint for creating a new data product submission, which transitions a draft to submission and queues validation.

methods.name: GetSubmissionResponse get_submission( submission_id: str, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security) )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve details of a specific submission by its ID.

methods.name: TriggerValidationResponse trigger_validation( submission_id: str, request: TriggerValidationRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security) )
methods.description: API endpoint to trigger validation and quality gates for a specific submission.

methods.name: ApproveSubmissionResponse approve_submission( submission_id: str, request: ApproveSubmissionRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security) )
methods.description: API endpoint for approved or rejecting a submission with signature validation, SoD checks, and evidence package creation.
